name: hippus_warrior
description: a Hippus Warrior (Fall from Heaven), a bearded, dark-haired horse nomad fighting on foot: a tall peaked orange cap with a cream fur brim and a long orange feather plume sweeping back, an orange coat with cream fur trim over a brown plaid tunic, a brown belt with a brass buckle, brown trousers and brown boots, a studded wooden club raised in his RIGHT hand and a round red-brown wooden shield with a brass rim, brass studs and a brass boss on his LEFT arm
hands: the studded wooden club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the round shield stays on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the studded club is lifted beside the head with its studded head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the studded club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the studded club is level, its studded head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the studded club head smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the studded club carries on down until its head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the orange feather plume trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the studded club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, shield flung out to the right), the feather plume whipping
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the studded club dipping, shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the studded club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the head of the studded club resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the studded club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the plumed cap tipping
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the plumed fur cap still on his head; the studded club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the studded club and the round shield on the ground beside him
